import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-right: Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(payment_counts.values, 
                                            labels=payment_counts.index,
                                            autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                            colors=colors_pie,
                                            startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(10)
    text.set_fontweight('bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 3. Bottom-left: Sales by Customer Age Group and Takeaway Status
age_takeaway = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_takeaway = age_takeaway.reindex(age_order, fill_value=0)
x = np.arange(len(age_takeaway.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[1, 0].bar(x - width/2, age_takeaway[0], width, label='Dine-in', color='#3498db')
bars2 = axes[1, 0].bar(x + width/2, age_takeaway[1], width, label='Takeaway', color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Age Group and Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(age_takeaway.index, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].legend(fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Bottom-right: Average Transaction Value by Product and Size
avg_trans = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
existing_sizes = [s for s in size_order if s in avg_trans.columns]
avg_trans = avg_trans[existing_sizes]
avg_trans_sorted = avg_trans.sort_values(by=existing_sizes, ascending=False)

avg_trans_sorted.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#95a5a6', '#f39c12', '#27ae60'], width=0.8)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product and Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Size', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(avg_trans_sorted.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
